summary: Learn to investigate conflict-related sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) through our course. Empower yourself to make a difference in this field.
lede: Conflict-related SGBV investigation training helps investigators assess allegations and plan safe, evidence-led inquiries. It is designed for investigators, human rights officers, protection specialists, and legal advisers. Participants practise survivor-centred interviews and informed consent, assess source reliability and corroborate accounts, preserve digital evidence with custody records and secure workflows, and construct incident timelines and pattern assessments for case files and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate, document, analyse, refer, or oversee conflict-related SGBV cases and need a consistent foundation-to-intermediate method for safe evidence collection.
prerequisites: No formal legal or investigative qualification is required. You should bring basic familiarity with confidential case information, safeguarding, or field documentation. You do not need programming skills. A laptop is recommended for digital evidence-register exercises, but the course can use provided templates if a laptop is unavailable. Exercises use fictionalised or anonymised training materials and do not require disclosure of personal, survivor, witness, or operational information.
